method: Root decoded directly from the supplied finite lexicon and integer chart; no encoder, decoder or expected-source file used.
exact_token_string: yara , wait wait . drink water . uncharacteristically, water is not warm .
ordinary_message: Yara, wait, wait. Drink water. Uncharacteristically, water is not warm.
manual_trace: cfh + cphn,a,sh,a gives literal indices25,1,18,1: yara.
r is root rank10 and the terminal comma; s is root rank9 and terminal full stop.
oaaaa follows d,r,i,n,k, stopping at terminal drink despite its s child.
yaeaa follows w,a,t,e,r; ea follows i,s; iaa follows n,o,t; yaoa follows w,a,r,m.

Third row payload after literal header: cpha,t,e,y,a,sh,a,e,cth,n,sh,s,ckh,cth,s,e,a,m,m,cphn gives uncharacteristically. Final cfh is continuation, not a source letter. Next-row cphy is index28, attached comma.

line_boundaries.row1_to_row2: ordinary source space after full stop
line_boundaries.row2_to_row3: ordinary source space after full stop
line_boundaries.row3_to_row4: no source space; cfh continuation joins cphy to unknown token

friction: Small branch chart made recovery straightforward, but each character requires a local child list or traversal of a complete trie. A full wordbook would make this lookup cost much larger.
Multiletter working labels were manually separated as drawings; this is an artificial notation lesson, not an ink-reading test.
Capitalization and editorial sentence punctuation in ordinary_message are presentation only; exact_token_string preserves the actual lowercase source tokens and attached comma.
limits: Does not measure historical usability, native statistics or word meanings.
The disclosed finite-alphabet physical-domain limit is retained; the N=28 lesson lies within the sufficient N<=440 domain.
